WebSearch: Richard Berry for Mayor Albuquerque 2013 campaign site
WebFetch and mac2 curl: https://ballotpedia.org/Richard_Berry (empty or 403)
Wayback CDX via mac2 for richardberry.com, berryformayor.com, richardberryformayor.com, mayorrichardberry.com, berryforabq.com, richardberry.org, electrichardberry.com
note: Searches ran and every domain was checked in the archive. richardberry.com, richardberryformayor.com, mayorrichardberry.com and berryforabq.com have no 200 captures in the window. berryformayor.com (14 captures, May to Jul 2013) and electrichardberry.com (captured 2013-05-30) show a GoDaddy parking page, not a Berry campaign site. richardberry.org is a photographer's site. No lead gave Berry's real 2013 domain, so no site was accepted. Ballotpedia could not be read.
